description: Source code for the EC host command backend implementation for Nuvoton NPCX SHI interface, including initialization, interrupt handling, and communication protocols.

methods.name: shi_npcx_read_buf_pointer
methods.description: Reads the buffer pointer for input or output buffer by consecutive register reading.

methods.name: shi_npcx_write_buf_pointer
methods.description: Writes the buffer pointer for output buffer by consecutive register reading, used in enhanced buffer mode.

methods.name: shi_npcx_valid_obuf_offset
methods.description: Calculates the valid offset in the output buffer for writing, depending on buffer mode.

methods.name: shi_npcx_write_half_outbuf
methods.description: Writes half of the output buffer from the message buffer.

methods.name: shi_npcx_read_inbuf_wait
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the input buffer, waiting until data is available or timeout.

methods.name: shi_npcx_fill_out_status
methods.description: Fills the output buffer with a status byte, handling different buffer modes.

methods.name: shi_npcx_bad_received_data
methods.description: Handles unexpected or invalid received data, resets state machine.

methods.name: shi_npcx_write_first_pkg_outbuf
methods.description: Writes the first package of response data into the output buffer.

methods.name: shi_npcx_handle_host_package
methods.description: Handles a complete host command package after reception.

methods.name: shi_npcx_host_request_expected_size
methods.description: Calculates the expected size of a host request based on header.

methods.name: shi_npcx_parse_header
methods.description: Parses the header of an incoming request and prepares for data reception.

methods.name: shi_npcx_sec_ibf_int_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the secondary input buffer full interrupt.

methods.name: shi_npcx_read_half_inbuf
methods.description: Reads half of the input buffer into the message buffer.

methods.name: shi_npcx_log_unexpected_state
methods.description: Logs unexpected state occurrences during interrupt handling.

methods.name: shi_npcx_handle_cs_assert
methods.description: Handles assertion of chip select, preparing for data reception.

methods.name: shi_npcx_handle_cs_deassert
methods.description: Handles deassertion of chip select, finalizing transaction.

methods.name: shi_npcx_handle_input_buf_half_full
methods.description: Handles half-full input buffer interrupt.

methods.name: shi_npcx_handle_input_buf_full
methods.description: Handles full input buffer interrupt.

methods.name: shi_npcx_isr
methods.description: Main interrupt service routine for SHI, dispatching events based on status registers.

methods.name: shi_npcx_reset_prepare
methods.description: Resets the SHI interface to initial state for next transaction.

methods.name: shi_npcx_enable
methods.description: Enables the SHI interface, including clock and interrupt configuration.

methods.name: shi_npcx_disable
methods.description: Disables the SHI interface, including clock and interrupt deactivation.

methods.name: shi_npcx_init_registers
methods.description: Initializes hardware registers for the SHI interface.

methods.name: shi_npcx_init
methods.description: Initializes the SHI device, including register setup and power management.

methods.name: shi_npcx_backend_init
methods.description: Initializes the backend context for host command communication.

methods.name: shi_npcx_backend_send
methods.description: Sends a response package over the SHI interface.

methods.name: ec_host_cmd_backend_get_shi_npcx
methods.description: Returns the backend structure for the SHI NPCX host command interface.
